product_summary: Wadpack Pvt. Ltd., SW-20, 2nd Phase, Apparel Park, KIADB Industrial Area, Doddaballapur, Bangalore 561203 (source: wadpack.com contact block, archived copy). Real catalogue per own website (wadpack.com, archived 2024): corrugated box manufacturing since 1976 — 3-ply, 5-ply and 7-ply corrugated boxes; Regular Slotted Container (RSC); heavy-duty corrugated boxes; die-cut boxes; 'cartoon boxes'; C48IB tobacco packaging boxes; C30IB packaging; cut-rag packaging; 100 KGS packaging; 'Oriental packaging'; cigarette packaging with aroma retention; SpaceKraft IBCs (Intermediate Bulk Containers) and packaging IBCs; archival boxes; spools; pallets; jigs; RTS (ready-to-sell) display packs. Industries served: apparel, automobiles, cigarettes, computer peripherals, engineering, FMCG, furniture, fresh produce, household appliances, pharmaceutical, precision equipment, solar panels, sports, tea, telecom, tobacco.
comment: HS mapping vs declared 481910;482390: 481910 (cartons/boxes/cases of corrugated paper or paperboard) is EXACT and is the core of the business — RSC, 3/5/7-ply corrugated boxes, die-cut boxes, tobacco/cigarette boxes, archival boxes all fall here. 482390 (other articles of paper pulp/paper/paperboard, cut to size) is PARTIAL — it plausibly covers spools, jigs, cut-to-size paperboard parts, but the site does not state materials per SKU, so this is a catch-all rather than a confirmed line. Missing from the declaration: 481920 (folding cartons/non-corrugated cartons — 'cartoon boxes', RTS display packs, printed retail packs); 481810 (toilet paper) is NOT applicable — do not add; 481940 (other sacks and bags incl. cones) may apply to bag-type packaging if offered, not evidenced; 441520 (pallets — the site lists 'Pallet' as a product, wooden pallets would be 441520, but material not stated, could be corrugated board pallets under 481910); 392310 (plastic boxes/cases) only if the IBC line is plastic — SpaceKraft IBCs are typically paperboard-based, so 481910/482390 is more likely, but the site does not specify. Industry misclassification: the claimed industry 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) is WRONG — the company is a corrugated packaging converter serving FMCG, tobacco, pharma, apparel, automotive, electronics; construction/DIY is not among the listed industries served. Trader signs: none — own plant, ISO 9002/9001/14001/45001 certifications, 4 decades of manufacturing, KIADB industrial plot; this is a manufacturer, not a trader. All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line or shipment record was checked in this task (out of scope), so nothing here is corroborated by a customs entry. Per project rule 3, the HS/industry mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection: company is retained, declared code 481910 confirmed as correct primary code, 482390 retained as secondary, and 481920 should be added to reflect the folding-carton/display-pack lines.
